columns.name: ticketstogenerate

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Service.ServiceCode,   
	Service.Name,   
	Service.AliasName,
	Service.Price, 
	Service.ServiceCatCode,
	Service.Commission,
	Service.Description,
	Service.CostPrice,
	Service.ProcessDays,
	Service.ProcessHours,
	Service.ProcessMin,
	Service.ResultRequired,
	Service.PrintOnNewPage,
	Service.ServiceResultTemplate,
	Service.Printable,
	Service.TicketRequired,
	Service.ServicePricePolicyCode,
	Service.ServiceResultStyleCode,
	Service.ServiceFlatDisc,
	Service.AllowSaleInDecimal,
	Service.ServiceTypeCode,
	Service.LockPrice,
	Service.LockDiscPerc,
	Service.LockServiceFlatDisc,
	Service.ServiceFlatTax,
	Service.ServiceGSTPerc,
	Service.SharePerc,
	Service.AdditionalCharges,
	Service.Active,
	Service.MinPrice,
	Service.MaxPrice,
	Service.TicketsToGenerate,
	Service.TicketIntervalInDays,
	Service.TicketExpiryInDays,
	Service.Tokenable
FROM 
	Service   
Where 
	Service.ServiceCode = :ar_sCode
